instruction: A cutaway turbofan jet-engine core showing clearly separate sections: a front intake lip and large fan, a series of stacked compressor stages of increasing then decreasing radius, an annular combustor region, and a turbine section, all around a central shaft. Sectioned so stages read distinctly.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a cutaway turbofan core. A cutaway turbofan jet-engine core showing clearly separate sections: a front intake lip and large fan, a series of stacked compressor stages of increasing then decreasing radius, an annular combustor region, and a turbine section, all around a central shaft. Sectioned so stages read distinctly. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
